notes.title: Update 1.6.5 Is Now Live! New GUI!!
notes.content:
This update includes a much needed UI Overhaul. We hope you guys find this update helpful. One of the exceptional features of the New Purchase Menu is that we have combined the "Purchase Foods" and "Table Upgrades" into 1 Menu, also giving us the ability to add more buyable items like decorations, and other functional upgrades. 

UI Changes

 New buttons!
 New Frames!
 New player HUD!
 New cooking indicators (raw, cooked, burnt) !
 New floating UI for cauldron Ingredients where as the last UI blocked your view.


Bugs We Fixed

- Adjusted customer intake to also reflect busy times of the day.
- Fixed a few issues with Patrick properly collecting dirty dishes.
- Fixed a scaling issue with the menus in certain screen resolutions. 
- Corrected font scaling for all UI interfaces.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1
notes.content:
Hey guys we have some patches for you! We made an attempt to address Patrick's behavior and after 100 runs he seems to be working fine. The player collision with the magic clover has been adjusted. The reputation is working much better giving you much more customers the higher your rep. 

We are tackling bugs as quickly as we can. Sorry for any conveniences with how the game runs so far. Thanks for all the feedback and kind words. =]

notes.title: Update 1.6 Is Now LIVE!
notes.content:
Bugs We Squashed
 Fixed the amount of time between customers coming in based on Rep. 
 Made magic clover more attainable. 
 Gnomes no longer get stuck on each other in the hallway.
 Bread roll chewing sound corrected.
 Improved cauldron placement issues. 



Features We Added
 Patrick can now be purchased at the door in the kitchen for 50 gold per day.
 Main menu button added to pause menu. 
 Added rubbish bin that deletes unwanted foods.
 Added name generator for the patrons. 


Side Notes

We are still looking into addressing the gnomes getting stuck in indefinite eating. Please feel free to give us feedback if you still experience this issue.

At this time we have still not found appropriate background music for the pub but we haven't given up. ;)

In Design

Multiple Item Carry - Korey, our programmer, is currently working on a prototype inventory system that will allow you to carry multiple clean utencils (including ready foods and drinks).

Might (hint hint) be coming out with decoration options so that you can customize YOUR pub. :)

Shout Outs

We have a special thanks for Chudders, Genises150, and GiOlio inside the game(just a tiny easter egg to show that your support in helping us improve the game for everyone hasn't gone unnoticed). We hope you guys enjoy it! Thank you for your support and feedback. It has been invaluable.

notes.title: Update 1.6 Is Coming This Week!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We have been working on a lot of the things you have told us about and we are very close to releasing this next update/patch with those elements addressed. We hope to add lots of content in the next few months to really spice up your game play, so please keep telling us your favorite parts of the game and share with us how you want to see the direction it takes. We will hold votes for some of the features that you guys come up with, and will do our very best to implement them in a timely fashion. We are currently managing two projects at this time, but this is our baby! :) so please help us to raise it into the best restaurant sim EVER!!!


K-Squared Game Studios Dream Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2 IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Bugs we squashed:


 Fixed oven so it doesn't steal the cauldron.
 Fixed bowl shelf so it doesn't steal the cauldron.
 Actually put info in credits.
 Improved user interface navigation for main menu.
 Scaling for multiple screen resolutions.
 Optimized gnome scripts.
 Fixed bowl rotation when picking them up.
 Shift key allows for running instead of  slow walking.
 Gnomes no longer reach for food/drink before you set it down.(which caused duplicate item)


New Features (possibly new bugs :D)


 New game and continue game loading screen.
 Mouse Y inversion option added to pause menu.
 Day cycle and day end summary implemented.
 Mugs now snap into place under the tap for easier placement.
 Magic clover spawns after serving some customers. You catch the clover to 
 be rewarded with a random amount of gold, rep, or recipe ingredients.
 In game sounds implemented:  [olist]
Gnome eating/drinking/sipping from bowl
Fire for fireplace and oven
Boiling sound for cooking all stews in the cauldron
Sizzling sound for meats grilling
All carryable object's drop sounds
Water filling sounds
Player footsteps
Improved gnome footsteps
[/olist]


Snags:

Patrick the helper gnome was not able to make it to the update, but he is hoping to make it to the next one! :D

We hope you enjoy these new updates and we look forward to hearing more of your feedback so that we can continue to make a game that you enjoy!




Best Wishes, 

K² Game Studios Dream Team

notes.title: UPDATES Coming VERY soon!!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have received a lot of feedback on release of this game, and we thank you for that!! We heard you, and without hesitation, we are moving on those comments. The following will be (fixed/added) to The Garden Pub:

- Audio for all interactables, and some animations.

- Mug Fill Assist - System that places mug under the tap for you, so that you can focus on other tasks.

- Pickups that give you random rewards (Reputation, Veggies, Meat, or Gold).

- EoD (End of Day) System - Shows results for the current day and offers rewards based on performance.

- Helper Gnome - Employable NPC that collects dirty dishes from the customers, and occasionally cleans different parts of the Pub.

- Mouse Y-Axis Inversion. ( For all our aviators :P ) 



We hope that this will help all of our current players and those of you looking forward to playing The Garden Pub to see that we are willing to put in the work. Feedback helps us to accomplish that work! Thank You All Very Much!! Have a WONDERFUL Day!!!

 Expect the roll out of this Update to be within the next week to week and a half


K² Game Studios Dream Team
